nodes.label: ADR-004: Subscription Enforcement via Middleware Guards
nodes.rationale: Per-handler subscription checks would be duplicated and easy to forget on new endpoints. Chose two reusable middleware functions — `RequireFullAccess()` and `RequireFeature(feature)` — returning HTTP 402 Payment Required, the semantically correct status the frontend checks specifically to trigger the upgrade modal. Trial usage caps (2 farms, 2 harvests) are enforced via Redis counters (`EnsureTrialUsageAllowed`) checked before any DB write. Trade-off: developers must remember to add the guard to new write endpoints (not automatic); Redis counters can drift from DB truth if flushed, recovered via lazy rehydration on next request.
